firstPlayerRule: The Forensic Scientist leads the opening crime sequence and places the first evidence markers. For formal presentations, the player to the Scientist’s left speaks first, then play proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: Roles are normally dealt randomly. For a first game, the rules recommend assigning the Forensic Scientist to the most expressive player.
Once the Scientist places the first marker, the other players may discuss freely; the clockwise sequence applies to presentations, not all discussion.
